clue.text: Wise king therefore left daughter on loch

indicators.note: left here means departed, so that word goes out of the king's name

parts.note: Solomon is the Old Testament king famed for his wisdom
so means therefore

explanation.surface: A sage monarch, having reasoned something out, leaves his daughter beside a Scottish lake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left' is the verb 'went away', not the direction, signalling that 'therefore' leaves the king; 'on' in an across clue means placed after.
explanation.definitionFit: Loch Lomond is the large freshwater lake north of Glasgow, Scotland's best-known loch.

clue.text: Capital's got the sun in Cyprus

definitions.note: the definition stands for a place located in Cyprus

parts.note: Lima is the capital of Peru, here with the possessive s

explanation.surface: A capital city enjoys sunshine on Cyprus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital' suggests Nicosia, Cyprus's capital, but it is Lima in Peru.
explanation.definitionFit: Limassol is a port city on the south coast of Cyprus, its second largest.

clue.text: Royal burgh and resort churlish about conservationists

explanation.walkthrough: A royal burgh is a Scottish town granted a royal charter.

clue.text: Runs into the barn, drunk, in 12's county

explanation.walkthrough: 'drunk' rearranges THE BARN into NABERTH, and R goes in after NA. 12 refers to Pembroke.
explanation.definitionFit: Narberth is a small market town in Pembrokeshire, south-west Wales.

clue.text: Healing ointment spoken of at castle

parts.note: a balm is a soothing healing ointment
oral means spoken rather than written

explanation.definitionFit: Balmoral in Aberdeenshire is the Scottish castle owned by the British royal family.

clue.text: Ran around edge of Dutch city

parts.note: a hem is the folded edge of cloth

clue.text: Amateur politician blocking letter in West Coast resort

clue.text: Russian town having roots around Volga, originally

clue.text: Remain around township near Wrexham

clue.text: Island off Senegal, unknown

clue.text: Posh car came in. Yes! Reversed into coach in county

definitions.meaning: a surrey is a light four-wheeled horse-drawn carriage
Surrey is the home county south-west of London

indicators.note: came in says the posh car goes into the middle of the other letters
Reversed tells us to read the word yes from the back

RR stands for Rolls-Royce, the archetypal grand car

explanation.surface: An excited arrival of a Rolls, with someone cheering as it backs into a coach somewhere in the shires.

explanation.definitionFit: A surrey is an American four-wheeled pleasure carriage, and Surrey is also a county bordering London.

clue.text: Pressure to take measure against bankrupt Welsh market town

clue.text: Bleepers haven't started ringing out in another royal burgh

clue.text: Call back in Shropshire town

clue.text: Oil painting of first and last halves of islands and Basque city

definitions.meaning: Picasso's 1937 anti-war canvas, painted in oils
a town in the Basque Country of northern Spain

indicators.note: first, paired with halves, says keep only the opening half of the first island, losing the rest

parts.note: Guernsey is one of the Channel Islands

explanation.definitionFit: Picasso named his famous canvas after the Basque town bombed in 1937, so the word is both picture and place.

clue.text: Marks on top-class trademark raised around new country

clue.text: Chap left to abandon one capital

to sink a plan is to abandon it

clue.text: Lands a part in amateur opera
